verdicts.decision_note: The FAQ establishes the $30 mint price, $10 referral commission, $8 founder share, and funding of both active prize pools as software-enforced settlement rules.
The client explicitly changes the per-mint allocation to $12 for the founder, $10 for the affiliate, and $8 for the remaining Small Block prize pool.

The payout and popup rules replace the prior $10 affiliate commission with a $25 accepted-referral credit and establish an $18 fallback commission; they do not remove the founder or prize-pool allocation.

The source concerns weighted recipient selection for referral-free commissions and tickets, which belongs to the narrower no-referral commission and ticket Requirements rather than the mint revenue split.
The source defines commission and ticket issuance coverage and reports missing weighted-draw records; it does not change the mint price or monetary revenue split.
The client specifies a $20 commission for the coded-referral mint path while separately describing the $18 no-code commission.

The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding payout logic of $35 for code-used mints and $12 for no-code mints; removing the superseded accepted-referral-credit key prevents conflicting commission values.
